persons.name: Jīvarakṣa
persons.evidence: deyadharmmo yaṃ ... bhikṣuśrījīvarakṣasya ... svayaṃ likhitaṃm itiḥ

purpose: yad atra puṇyaṃ tad bhavatv āmātāpitṛpūrvvaṅgamaṃ kṛtvā sarvasattvarāśer anuttarajñānaphalāptaye
notes: The scribe and donor is the Buddhist monk Jīvarakṣa, resident of Ṣaḍakṣarī Mahāvihāra, who copied the text himself (svayaṃ likhitam).
